generic.Defined scope/population: The single disability claim under review with its group policy and certificate in force at the date of disability
generic.In-scope period: Last day worked through the computed elimination period end date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy number, eligible class, date of disability, last day worked and elimination period end date on the claim header
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Provisions checked equal coverage, eligible class, elimination period and pre-existing look-back
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Policy extract and elimination period calculation filed to the claim folder with certificate version and pull date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Coverage gaps, class mismatches and pre-existing hits logged with a pend, deny or proceed disposition
generic.Test population: All coverage verifications completed on new STD and LTD claims in the review month
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if policy in force or eligible class is unconfirmed, or the elimination period end date is absent
generic.Exception handling path: Pend the claim, request written employer confirmation and route unresolved class disputes to the Claims Examiner
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Policy in force and eligible class confirmed for the date of disability with elimination period end date recorded
generic.Evidence location: Claim header and coverage folder in the claims management platform with the policy admin system extract attached

steps.title: Pull the group policy and certificate in the policy administration system
sop: Open the employer group policy in the policy administration system using the policy number on the claim
Download the certificate booklet version effective on the stated date of disability
Attach the extract to the claim in the claim file repository
Done when the correct certificate version is attached to the claim
verify: Check the certificate effective and termination dates bracket the date of disability
Pass when the attached certificate is the version in force at the date of disability

steps.title: Confirm the policy was in force on the date of disability in the policy admin system
sop: Read the policy status and premium payment history for the month containing the date of disability
Confirm no lapse, grace-period gap or termination applies on that date
Record the in-force confirmation on the claim coverage tab
Done when the in-force status is recorded with the source screen referenced
verify: Compare the recorded in-force date range against the policy status screen
Pass when the date of disability falls inside a confirmed in-force period

steps.title: Confirm actively-at-work eligible class membership in the policy admin system
sop: Locate the claimant on the employer eligibility record and read the assigned class
Confirm the hours threshold was met and the eligibility waiting period was served by the last day worked
Record the eligible class and the actively-at-work confirmation on the claim
Done when class, hours and waiting period are all recorded on the claim
verify: Recheck the hours threshold against the class definition in the certificate
Pass when the claimant is a confirmed eligible class member on the last day worked

steps.title: Compute the elimination period end date and record it on the claim header
sop: Read the elimination period length and accumulation rules from the certificate
Compute the end date from the date of disability and record it on the claim header field
Note the first payable day as the day after the elimination period ends
Done when the elimination period end date is stored in the header field
verify: Recompute the end date independently from the date of disability
Pass when the stored end date matches the recomputed date and the certificate rule

steps.title: Check the pre-existing condition limitation and look-back window in the certificate
sop: Read the pre-existing condition clause, the look-back months and the treatment-free rule
Compare the disabling diagnosis against treatment recorded in the look-back window
Record the pre-existing outcome as applies, does not apply or investigation required
Done when the pre-existing outcome is recorded with the clause cited
verify: Confirm the look-back window used matches the certificate months
Pass when a pre-existing outcome is recorded before coverage is confirmed

steps.title: Flag STD-to-LTD linkage on the claim in the claims management platform
sop: Search the claims platform for any STD claim on the same claimant and disabling condition
Link the related claim record rather than creating a reference in free text
Record whether the STD benefit period feeds the LTD elimination period
Done when the linkage flag is set and any related claim is linked
verify: Re-run the claimant search to confirm no unlinked related claim remains
Pass when every related STD claim is linked to the LTD claim record

steps.title: File the coverage evidence pack to the claim document repository
sop: Index the policy extract, eligibility record and elimination period calculation to the claim folder
Name each document with its type and source date so it can be retrieved on appeal
Log any unresolved coverage exception with its disposition on the claim
Done when all three coverage documents are indexed to the claim
verify: Open the claim folder and confirm each indexed document renders
Pass when the coverage pack is retrievable and every exception carries a disposition

generic.Defined scope/population: The eligibility determination and intake actions recorded on one disability claim record
generic.In-scope period: From receipt of the claim to 24 hours after the eligibility decision is made
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Claim status, eligibility outcome, rationale note, next diary date and author stamp on the claim record
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Documents indexed equal policy extract, employer statement and elimination period calculation
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Determination entry saved with author, timestamp and the certificate provision version cited
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Pended or incomplete eligibility items logged with the outstanding requirement and target date
generic.Test population: All eligibility determinations recorded in the claims platform in the review month
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the outcome sits only in free text or the entry is later than 24 hours after decision
generic.Exception handling path: Reopen the claim entry, correct the status field and record a correction note naming the original error
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Determination recorded in the status field within 24 hours with rationale, author and timestamp
generic.Evidence location: Claim status tab and notes log in the claims management platform with documents in the claim file repository

steps.title: Set the eligibility outcome in the claim status field in the claims platform
sop: Open the claim status tab and select approved, denied or pended from the coded status list
Do not rely on a free-text note to carry the outcome
Save the status change so the system stamps author and time
Done when the coded status reflects the eligibility outcome
verify: Reopen the claim and read the status field value and its stamp
Pass when the coded status matches the decision and carries an author and timestamp

steps.title: Attach the eligibility rationale note citing the certificate provision
sop: Write the rationale naming the certificate section and the facts relied on
Reference the coverage, class and elimination period findings by their source documents
Save the note against the claim rather than in a personal file
Done when the rationale note is saved on the claim
verify: Read the note and check a named certificate provision appears
Pass when the rationale cites the provision relied on and the supporting documents

steps.title: Index the eligibility document set to the claim document repository
sop: Index the policy extract, employer statement and elimination period calculation to the claim folder
Tag each document with type, source and receipt date
Confirm no document remains in a personal mailbox or local drive
Done when all three documents are indexed to the claim folder
verify: Count the indexed documents against the required set
Pass when the indexed count equals three with correct type tags

steps.title: Set the next diary date so the ERISA clock is visible on the desk list
sop: Set the diary date derived from the claim received date and the applicable decision window
Add a one-line instruction stating what the diary is for
Confirm the claim appears on the correct desk list after saving
Done when the diary is set and the claim shows on the desk list
verify: Filter the desk list for the claim and read its diary date
Pass when the diary date sits inside the applicable ERISA decision window

steps.title: Check the employer-facing view for exposed clinical detail
sop: Open the employer view of the claim in the claims platform
Read every visible field for diagnosis, treatment or clinical narrative
Move any clinical text into a restricted clinical note
Done when the employer view carries no clinical content
verify: Re-open the employer view after the change and scan the visible fields
Pass when no diagnosis or clinical detail is visible in the employer view

steps.title: Log outstanding eligibility exceptions with dispositions on the claim
sop: List each missing or disputed eligibility item as a coded exception
Record the disposition and the responsible party for each
Set a follow-up diary for each open exception
Done when every open exception carries a disposition and a follow-up date
verify: Review the exception list for entries without a disposition
Pass when no eligibility exception is open without a disposition and date

generic.Defined scope/population: The eligibility determination notice issued to one claimant on a registered disability claim
generic.In-scope period: From the eligibility decision date to the notice delivery date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Letter template code, outcome, certificate provision cited, mailing address and issue date on the claim
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Notices issued equal eligibility decisions recorded for the period
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Issued letter stored as a PDF on the claim with template version and send date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Returned mail and undeliverable notices logged with the re-issue action taken
generic.Test population: All eligibility determination notices issued in the review month
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if an adverse notice omits appeal rights or the 180-day appeal window statement
generic.Exception handling path: Withdraw and re-issue the corrected notice, restart the delivery record and note the correction reason
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Notice issued with the correct template, reason, provision cited and appeal rights on adverse outcomes
generic.Evidence location: Correspondence folder on the claim in the claims management platform and the claim file repository

steps.title: Select the outcome-matched letter template in the claims platform
sop: Open the correspondence module and choose approval, denial or pend-for-information
Confirm the template version is the current approved version
Populate the merge fields from the claim record rather than typing them
Done when the correct template is selected and merged
verify: Compare the selected template code against the recorded outcome
Pass when the template matches the determination outcome

steps.title: State the certificate provision and reason on any adverse outcome
sop: Insert the specific certificate section number and the reason relied on
Avoid generic wording such as not eligible under the plan
Confirm the reason matches the rationale note on the claim
Done when the provision and specific reason appear in the letter
verify: Compare the letter reason against the claim rationale note
Pass when the letter reason and the file rationale state the same basis

steps.title: Add the description of additional information needed and why
sop: List each outstanding item the claimant must supply
Explain in plain language why each item is necessary to decide
State the date by which the information is needed
Done when every outstanding item is listed with its reason and due date
verify: Cross-check the listed items against the open claim requirements
Pass when each open requirement appears in the letter with a reason

steps.title: Insert the ERISA appeal rights paragraph on denials
sop: Insert the approved appeal rights block covering how and where to appeal
Confirm the 180-day appeal window and the right-to-sue statement are present
Confirm the free-copy-of-documents offer is present
Done when the full appeal rights block appears on the adverse notice
verify: Read the adverse notice for the appeal window and civil action wording
Pass when appeal rights, the 180-day window and right-to-sue all appear

steps.title: Verify the mailing address against the employer eligibility record
sop: Compare the claim mailing address against the employer eligibility record
Apply any claimant-requested alternative address or representative address on file
Correct the claim address record before release rather than editing the letter
Done when the address on the letter matches the verified claim address
verify: Re-read the address block on the merged letter
Pass when the letter address matches the verified record on the claim

steps.title: Release the notice and record the delivery date on the claim
sop: Release the letter through the correspondence queue and capture the send confirmation
File the issued PDF to the claim correspondence folder
Record the delivery date and channel on the claim and close the notice task
Done when the issued letter and delivery date are recorded on the claim
verify: Open the correspondence folder and read the stored letter and send date
Pass when the issued letter is on file with a recorded delivery date

generic.Defined scope/population: The employer status notification for one disability claim sent to the named benefits or HR contact
generic.In-scope period: From the eligibility decision to the expected first benefit payment date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Employer contact name, claim status, elimination period end date and expected first payment date
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Employer notifications sent equal claims with a recorded eligibility outcome for the period
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Sent notification filed to the claim correspondence folder with recipient and send timestamp
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Employer contact mismatches and salary continuance conflicts logged with the resolution
generic.Test population: All employer status notifications sent on disability claims in the review month
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any diagnosis or clinical detail appears, or the recipient is not the named employer contact
generic.Exception handling path: Recall or correct the notification, notify the privacy team of any clinical disclosure and log the incident
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Notification logged with recipient name and send date and containing no clinical detail
generic.Evidence location: Claim correspondence folder in the claims management platform with the sent email retained

steps.title: Confirm the named employer benefits contact on the claim record
sop: Open the employer record linked to the claim and read the named benefits or HR contact
Confirm the contact is current and authorised to receive claim status
Do not copy line managers or unnamed group mailboxes
Done when the single authorised recipient is confirmed on the claim
verify: Compare the intended recipient against the employer record contact
Pass when the recipient matches the named authorised contact

steps.title: Draft the status notification with status, elimination date and payment date
sop: State the claim status, the elimination period end date and the expected first payment date
Keep the content to administrative facts only
Use the approved employer notification template in the claims platform
Done when the draft carries the three required administrative facts
verify: Read the draft against the claim header values
Pass when the stated dates match the claim header exactly

steps.title: Strip any diagnosis or clinical wording from the draft
sop: Read the draft line by line for diagnosis, treatment or clinical findings
Replace any clinical wording with a neutral status statement
Confirm attachments carry no clinical content either
Done when the draft and attachments are free of clinical detail
verify: Re-read the final draft and its attachments for clinical terms
Pass when no diagnosis, treatment or medical record appears

steps.title: Ask the employer to confirm salary continuance or sick pay coverage
sop: Ask whether salary continuance or sick pay runs through the elimination period
Ask for the start and end dates and the gross amounts paid
State that the answer affects the first payable date and offsets
Done when the salary continuance question is included in the notification
verify: Check the sent notification contains the salary continuance question
Pass when the question and its date range request are present

steps.title: Ask the employer to confirm last day worked and any return to work
sop: Ask the employer to confirm the last day worked recorded in payroll
Ask whether any return to work, partial or full, has been recorded
Request a written reply rather than a phone confirmation
Done when both confirmations are requested in writing
verify: Compare the employer reply against the claim last day worked field
Pass when the employer confirmation matches or a variance is logged

steps.title: Send the notification and file it to the claim correspondence folder
sop: Send the notification to the confirmed recipient from the claims platform or corporate email
File the sent item to the claim correspondence folder
Record the recipient name and send date on the claim activity log
Done when the sent notification is filed with recipient and date
verify: Open the correspondence folder and read the logged recipient and date
Pass when the notification is on file with recipient name and send date

generic.Defined scope/population: HIPAA authorisations and attending physician statements for every treating provider named on one claim
generic.In-scope period: The treatment period for the disabling condition covered by the authorisation
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Authorisation signature, date, named providers, expiry date and the requested record date range
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Record requests sent equal treating providers named on the claim form
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed authorisation and each returned record set indexed with provider and receipt date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Expired, unsigned or refused authorisations logged with the remediation action
generic.Test population: All medical record requests raised on new disability claims in the review month
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any record was requested before a signed, dated and unexpired authorisation was on file
generic.Exception handling path: Suspend the request, obtain a fresh authorisation and quarantine any records received without one
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Valid authorisation on file before requests, GINA wording included and follow-ups diarised at 10 business days
generic.Evidence location: OpenText document management indexed to the claim in the claims management platform

steps.title: Obtain the signed HIPAA authorisation and check it in the claims platform
sop: Send the authorisation form naming each disclosing provider and the record date range
On return, check the signature, the date and the expiry date
Index the signed authorisation to the claim before any request is raised
Done when a signed, dated and unexpired authorisation is indexed to the claim
verify: Read the indexed authorisation for signature, date and expiry
Pass when the authorisation is signed, dated and unexpired at the request date

steps.title: List the treating providers named on the claim form in the claim record
sop: Read the claimant and attending physician sections for every treating provider
Record each provider with specialty and contact details on the claim
Flag any provider named in the records but missing from the authorisation
Done when every treating provider is recorded on the claim
verify: Compare the provider list against the claim form entries
Pass when every named provider appears on the claim provider list

steps.title: Send the Attending Physician Statement request to each provider
sop: Issue the APS request to every recorded treating provider with the authorisation attached
State the questions on restrictions, prognosis and expected return-to-work date
Log each request on the claim with the send date
Done when an APS request is logged for every recorded provider
verify: Count logged requests against the recorded provider list
Pass when requests sent equal providers named on the claim

steps.title: Scope the records request to the disabling condition and treatment period
sop: Limit the request to the disabling condition and the relevant treatment date range
Remove any entire-chart or open-ended wording from the request
State the specific record types needed such as office notes, imaging and therapy notes
Done when every outbound request carries a bounded condition and date range
verify: Read the sent request for open-ended wording
Pass when no request seeks the entire chart or an unbounded period

steps.title: Include the GINA safe-harbor wording on the provider request
sop: Insert the approved GINA safe-harbor paragraph in the request template
Confirm it appears on the covering page the provider reads first
Note the wording version used on the claim log
Done when the GINA notice is present on each request sent
verify: Open the sent request and locate the GINA paragraph
Pass when the GINA safe-harbor notice appears on every request

steps.title: Diary outstanding requests at 10 business days and log follow-ups
sop: Set a 10 business day diary on each outstanding record request
Chase by phone or fax on the diary date and log the attempt and outcome
Escalate to the Disability Case Manager after a second failed chase
Done when every open request carries a diary and logged follow-up
verify: Review open requests for missing diary dates or unlogged chases
Pass when no request is open past the SLA without a logged chase

steps.title: Index returned records and confirm sufficiency for clinical review
sop: Index each returned record set in OpenText with provider name and service dates
Check the returned records cover the period under review
Raise a supplementary request where the returned set is incomplete
Done when the returned records are indexed and sufficiency is recorded
verify: Compare indexed record date ranges against the review period
Pass when the indexed records cover the full review period or a gap request is open

generic.Defined scope/population: One new disability claim notified by an employer, claimant or treating provider
generic.In-scope period: From the claim received date through registration and queue routing on the same day
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Date of disability, last day worked, occupation, employer division, reporting source and received date
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Registered claims equal notifications received in the intake queue for the day
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Claimant, employer and physician statement sections attached with receipt timestamps
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Duplicate or incomplete notifications logged with a link, merge or reject disposition
generic.Test population: All disability claims registered in the claims platform in the review month
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a second open claim exists for the same claimant and disabling condition
generic.Exception handling path: Link the related claim, close the duplicate record and record the merge decision and approver
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Claim registered with both key dates populated, no duplicate open claim and routed to a case management queue
generic.Evidence location: Claim record in the claims management platform with attachments in the claim file repository

steps.title: Search the claims platform for an existing claim before creating a record
sop: Search by national identifier and employee id across STD and LTD claims
Review any hit for the same disabling condition
Link rather than create where an existing claim covers the same condition
Done when the duplicate search is completed and its result recorded
verify: Re-run the identifier search after registration
Pass when no second open claim exists for the same claimant and condition

steps.title: Create the claim record and capture the header data
sop: Create the claim and enter date of disability, last day worked, occupation and employer division
Select values from coded lists where available rather than free text
Save the header and confirm no mandatory field warning remains
Done when the claim header is saved with all four values populated
verify: Reopen the header and read the four captured values
Pass when date of disability and last day worked are both populated

steps.title: Record the reporting source and received date that start the ERISA clock
sop: Select employer, claimant or treating provider as the reporting source
Enter the received date exactly as stamped on the notification
Do not substitute the assignment date for the received date
Done when source and received date are recorded on the claim
verify: Compare the recorded received date against the notification stamp
Pass when the recorded received date matches the notification stamp

steps.title: Attach the claimant, employer and physician statement sections
sop: Index each completed statement section to the new claim in the claim file repository
Flag any section that is missing or unsigned as an open requirement
Set a diary for the outstanding sections
Done when all received sections are attached and gaps are logged
verify: Count attached sections against the three required sections
Pass when each missing section carries an open requirement and diary

steps.title: Route the claim to the correct case management queue
sop: Select the queue by product, STD or LTD, and by diagnosis category
Route through the workflow tool so the assignment is auditable
Confirm the claim appears on the receiving queue
Done when the claim sits on the correct Disability Case Manager queue
verify: Open the receiving queue and locate the claim
Pass when the claim appears on the queue matching product and diagnosis

steps.title: Confirm registration completeness before releasing the claim to handling
sop: Review the header, source, attachments and routing on the new claim
Correct any field captured as free text where a coded value exists
Record the registration quality check on the claim log
Done when the registration check is recorded on the claim
verify: Re-read the claim header and attachment list after the check
Pass when all required fields are valid and the check is logged

generic.Defined scope/population: The initial liability decision on one disability claim subject to the ERISA decision clock
generic.In-scope period: From the claim received date to the decision date, excluding documented tolled periods
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Received date, decision due date, extension notice date, definition applied and decision rationale
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Decisions rendered plus open extensions equal claims with a clock started in the period
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Decision rationale and any extension notice stored on the claim with issue timestamps
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Late decisions and untimely extensions logged with cause and remediation
generic.Test population: All initial liability decisions rendered on disability claims in the review month
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the decision exceeds 45 days from receipt without a timely extension notice on file
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate a slipping clock before day 45, issue the extension notice and record the breach if missed
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Decision within 45 days of receipt or a documented extension, with the definition of disability cited
generic.Evidence location: Claim decision tab and compliance clock task in the claims management platform

steps.title: Confirm the 45-day clock is measured from the claim received date
sop: Read the received date on the claim and the system-calculated decision due date
Correct the due date where it was calculated from the assignment date
Record the corrected due date on the compliance clock task
Done when the due date is measured from the received date
verify: Recalculate 45 days from the received date
Pass when the system due date equals the recalculated date

steps.title: Confirm coverage, earnings and clinical review are on file
sop: Check the claim holds coverage confirmation, verified pre-disability earnings and a clinical review
Raise the missing item as an open requirement where any is absent
Do not render a decision on an incomplete file
Done when all three components are confirmed present or chased
verify: List the three components against the claim document index
Pass when all three are on file before the decision is recorded

steps.title: Issue any extension notice before day 45 through the claims platform
sop: Assess by the extension checkpoint diary whether the decision will land on time
Issue the extension notice stating the reason and the expected decision date
File the notice and log the send date on the compliance clock task
Done when the extension notice is issued before day 45 where needed
verify: Compare the extension notice send date against day 45 from receipt
Pass when the notice date precedes the original deadline

steps.title: Record the tolled period for any claimant information request
sop: Stop the clock only for a documented request for claimant information
Record the tolling start date, the request and the date the information arrived
Restart the clock on receipt and recompute the due date
Done when each tolled period is recorded with start and end dates
verify: Check each tolled period has a matching documented information request
Pass when no tolling exists without a documented claimant request

steps.title: Record the decision rationale citing the definition of disability applied
sop: State whether the own-occupation or any-occupation definition was applied and why
Link the clinical and vocational findings that support the conclusion
Save the rationale to the claim decision tab
Done when the rationale naming the applicable definition is saved
verify: Read the rationale for the named definition and supporting findings
Pass when the rationale cites the applicable definition-of-disability provision

steps.title: Have the case manager review the decision pack before release
sop: Review the clinical and vocational evidence against the stated rationale
Raise any gap back to the Claims Examiner before the decision is released
Record the review outcome on the claim
Done when the case manager review is recorded on the claim
verify: Read the recorded review outcome and any raised gaps
Pass when the review is logged and open gaps are resolved or accepted

steps.title: Close the compliance clock task and log the decision date
sop: Record the decision date and close the compliance clock task
Compare elapsed days against the applicable window and flag any breach
Log a breach exception with cause where the window was exceeded
Done when the clock task is closed with elapsed days recorded
verify: Read elapsed days against the 45-day window and any extension
Pass when the decision is inside the window or a timely extension is on file

generic.Defined scope/population: Pre-disability covered earnings and employment status for one claimant under the certificate definition
generic.In-scope period: The pre-disability earnings look-back defined in the certificate, commonly 12 or 24 months
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Employer wage source, earnings components included, look-back months and the confirmed earnings figure
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Employer-reported earnings reconcile to covered earnings recorded at enrolment
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Employer wage statement or payroll extract attached with issue date and preparer
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Variances above 10 percent logged with the explanation and the figure adopted
generic.Test population: All earnings verifications completed on disability claims in the review month
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any earnings figure relies solely on an unverified claimant statement
generic.Exception handling path: Request a corrected employer wage statement and pend the benefit calculation until it is received
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Verified earnings recorded on the financial tab with the employer source document attached
generic.Evidence location: Claim financial tab in the claims management platform with the payroll extract in the claim folder

steps.title: Request the employer wage statement covering the certificate look-back
sop: Request the wage statement or payroll extract for the defined pre-disability period
State the exact date range and the earnings components required
Log the request and set a follow-up diary on the claim
Done when the employer wage request is sent and logged
verify: Compare the requested date range against the certificate look-back
Pass when the requested range matches the certificate definition

steps.title: Apply the certificate definition of covered earnings
sop: Read the covered earnings definition and note whether bonus, commission and overtime are included
Exclude components the certificate excludes even where the employer reported them
Record the inclusion decisions on the earnings worksheet
Done when each earnings component is marked included or excluded
verify: Compare the worksheet inclusions against the certificate wording
Pass when component treatment matches the certificate definition

steps.title: Average variable pay over the contract-defined look-back in Excel
sop: Build the averaging calculation in the earnings workbook over the certificate look-back months
Exclude periods of unpaid leave where the certificate directs
Record the months used and the averaged monthly figure
Done when the averaged figure and the months used are recorded
verify: Recompute the average from the payroll extract totals
Pass when the recomputed average equals the recorded figure

steps.title: Reconcile employer-reported earnings to enrolment covered earnings
sop: Compare the employer figure against the covered earnings recorded at enrolment in the policy system
Quantify the variance in amount and percentage
Explain any variance over 10 percent and record the explanation
Done when the reconciliation and any variance explanation are recorded
verify: Read the variance percentage and its explanation
Pass when every variance over 10 percent carries a documented explanation

steps.title: Record the confirmed pre-disability earnings on the claim financial tab
sop: Enter the confirmed monthly covered earnings figure and its effective date
Attach the employer source document and the earnings worksheet
Note the source document reference against the figure
Done when the figure is recorded with its source attached
verify: Open the financial tab and confirm the figure and attachment
Pass when the recorded figure ties to the attached employer document

steps.title: Review the earnings verification before it drives the benefit calculation
sop: Review the source document, component treatment and reconciliation
Reject any figure supported only by a claimant statement
Record the review outcome and release the figure for calculation
Done when the review outcome is recorded on the claim
verify: Check the released figure has an employer source document
Pass when no released earnings figure rests on an unverified claimant statement

generic.Defined scope/population: The claimant's documented restrictions and limitations assessed against the applicable disability definition
generic.In-scope period: The review period covered by the current medical evidence and the definition in force on that date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Definition applied, transition date, occupational duties, restrictions and supported exertional level
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Occupational duties listed equal duties mapped to a restriction assessment
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assessment saved on the claim with reviewer name, credentials and assessment date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Conflicts between attending physician opinion and objective findings logged with the resolution
generic.Test population: All functional capacity assessments recorded on disability claims in the review month
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any stated restriction lacks a supporting clinical document reference
generic.Exception handling path: Refer unresolved conflicts to peer review or an IME before the assessment is relied on
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Restrictions mapped to occupational demands with the applicable definition and exertional level named
generic.Evidence location: Clinical assessment note on the claim in the claims management platform with source records in the claim folder

steps.title: State the applicable disability definition and transition date on the claim
sop: Read the certificate to identify whether own-occupation or any-occupation applies at the review date
Record the own-occupation end date and the any-occupation transition date on the claim
Flag where the review straddles the transition date
Done when the applicable definition and transition date are recorded
verify: Compare the recorded definition against the certificate and the review date
Pass when the recorded definition is the one in force at the review date

steps.title: List the material and substantial duties of the own occupation
sop: Obtain the employer job description and the occupation as performed in the national economy
List each material and substantial duty with its physical and cognitive demand
File the duty list to the claim document folder
Done when the duty list is filed against the claim
verify: Count listed duties against the job description content
Pass when every material duty in the source description appears on the list

steps.title: Map documented restrictions to each occupational duty
sop: Take each restriction covering lift, carry, sit, stand, reach and cognition
Map it against each listed duty and mark the duty as supported or not supported
Cite the source clinical document for each restriction used
Done when every duty carries a mapped restriction outcome
verify: Check each mapped restriction has a cited clinical document
Pass when no restriction is stated without a supporting document reference

steps.title: Record the exertional level supported by the evidence
sop: Select sedentary, light, medium or heavy based on the mapped restrictions

generic.Defined scope/population: One received disability appeal requiring an ERISA acknowledgement to the claimant or authorised representative

steps.title: Insert the exhaustion statement and the ERISA 502(a) right-to-sue disclosure

steps.title: Obtain legal review of the final adverse determination wording

Mark up any wording that overstates or understates the basis for the decision
Record the legal review outcome and the reviewer on the appeal record

steps.title: Confirm the letter issues inside the appeal decision window or a documented extension

File the issued copy to the claim file repository as part of the administrative record

Pass when the letter is recorded as issued with its date and recipients

generic.Defined scope/population: Independent clinical and, where capacity is disputed, vocational opinions supporting one appeal review

generic.Required fields populated and valid: Reviewer name, credentials, specialty, question set, opinion date and receipt date on each opinion

generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed opinions filed in the document repository with reviewer credentials and receipt dates
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Late, incomplete or conflicted opinions logged with the recommission action and its date

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a decision relies on an opinion where the claimant had no opportunity to respond

steps.title: Confirm the clinical reviewer independence before commissioning the opinion
sop: Check the candidate reviewer against the original determination participants recorded on the claim

Record the independence check and the reviewer credentials on the appeal record

steps.title: Engage an independent vocational expert where vocational capacity is disputed
sop: Read the appeal issues to determine whether vocational capacity or earnings capacity is in dispute

Record the vocational engagement and its scope on the appeal record

verify: Compare the engagement decision to the disputed issues listed on the appeal

steps.title: Send the complete administrative record and question set to each reviewer
sop: Send the assembled record including the claimant new appeal evidence to each reviewer

Record the despatch date and the report due date on the appeal record

verify: Compare the record sent to the record index for the appeal
Pass when the reviewer received the complete indexed record including new appeal evidence

steps.title: Review each returned opinion for completeness and signature
sop: Check each opinion answers every question in the question set

Return incomplete opinions to the reviewer with the gaps identified and log the return
Done when each accepted opinion is complete, signed and credentialed
verify: Read each accepted opinion against the question set issued
Pass when every question is answered and every opinion is signed and credentialed

steps.title: Give the claimant the opportunity to respond to any new reviewer report
sop: Send the claimant a copy of any new reviewer report generated during the appeal
State a reasonable date by which a response will be considered before the decision
Log the send date and any response received on the appeal record
Done when each new reviewer report has been sent and the response window logged
verify: Compare the report send dates and response window to the appeal decision date

steps.title: File the signed opinions with credentials and receipt dates
sop: Index each signed opinion to the appeal clinical folder in the document repository
Record the reviewer name, credentials, specialty and the date each opinion was received
Link the opinions to the appeal record so they appear on the record index
Done when every opinion is indexed with credentials and receipt date
verify: Count indexed opinions against the opinions commissioned on the appeal record
Pass when the counts reconcile and each has credentials and a receipt date

steps.title: Summarise the opinions for the appeal decision maker
sop: Summarise the accepted restrictions, the unsupported restrictions and the vocational conclusions

Save the summary to the appeal record for the decision maker to rely on

verify: Trace each statement in the summary to a filed opinion by reviewer and date
Pass when every summary conclusion traces to a signed filed opinion

generic.Defined scope/population: One exhausted disability appeal referred to litigation counsel with its complete administrative record
generic.In-scope period: From the final determination date through the referral date and the applicable limitation period
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Referral date, panel counsel, matter number, limitation date and litigation hold flag on the claim
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Documents transmitted to counsel reconcile to the record index as it stood at the final determination
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Transmitted record retained with the transmission date and the record index version referenced
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Post-determination documents, missing holds and late referrals logged with the action taken
generic.Test population: All appeals referred to litigation counsel in the review period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any document was added to the administrative record after the final determination date
generic.Exception handling path: Record integrity issues are escalated to Legal Counsel and resolved before the matter is instructed
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Referral date, panel counsel and litigation hold recorded with an unaltered post-determination record
generic.Evidence location: Legal matter management system with the transmitted record retained in OpenText Document Mgmt

steps.title: Confirm all mandatory appeal levels are exhausted on the claim record
sop: Read the plan appeal structure and confirm each mandatory level has a completed determination

Record the exhaustion confirmation and its basis on the claim before referral

verify: Compare the completed determinations to the mandatory appeal levels in the plan
Pass when every mandatory level is complete or deemed exhaustion is documented

steps.title: Apply the litigation hold to the claim file in the claims management platform
sop: Set the litigation hold flag on the claim so archiving and purging are blocked

Record the hold date and the instructing counsel on the claim
Done when the litigation hold is applied and recorded on the claim
verify: Attempt the archive action and confirm the hold blocks it
Pass when the claim cannot be archived or purged while the hold is set

steps.title: Freeze the administrative record as it stood at the final determination
sop: Compare the current record index to the index as at the final determination date

Record the frozen index version that will be transmitted to counsel
Done when the frozen record index is agreed and post-determination items are quarantined
verify: Read the index entry dates against the final determination date

steps.title: Transmit the complete administrative record to panel counsel
sop: Transmit the frozen record and its index to the instructed panel counsel by the secure route

Confirm counsel acknowledges receipt of the full record

verify: Count the transmitted documents against the frozen record index
Pass when the transmitted count reconciles to the frozen index

steps.title: Open the matter in the legal matter management system with the limitation date
sop: Open the matter with the claim reference, referral date and responsible counsel
Record the applicable contractual or statutory limitation date on the matter
Set the diary reminders ahead of the limitation date
Done when the matter is open with the referral date and limitation date recorded
verify: Read the matter record for referral date, limitation date and diary entries
Pass when all three are present on the matter record

steps.title: Instruct panel counsel and record the budget and rate agreement
sop: Confirm the firm instructed is on the approved panel for ERISA disability litigation

Issue the instruction letter setting out scope and reporting expectations
Done when panel counsel is instructed with budget and rates recorded
verify: Read the matter record for the panel firm, budget and agreed rates
Pass when the instructed firm is on the panel and budget and rates are recorded

steps.title: Record the referral on the claim and notify the claims handler
sop: Record the referral date, matter number and instructed counsel on the claim record
Set the claim status to reflect litigation so routine handling actions stop
Notify the handling team that all further contact routes through counsel
Done when the referral is recorded on the claim and the handling team is notified
verify: Read the claim record for referral date, matter number and litigation status
Pass when referral date, panel counsel and litigation hold are all recorded on the claim

generic.Defined scope/population: One inbound appeal request registered against its parent claim and adverse determination

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Appeal logged with received date and linked to the parent claim and determination on an independent queue

sop: Read the receipt stamp on the inbound appeal document or the secure message receipt time

Attach the stamped inbound document to the appeal record

steps.title: Link the appeal to the parent claim and the determination being appealed
sop: Search for the parent claim by claim number or claimant identifier and link the appeal to it
Select the specific adverse determination being appealed and link it to the appeal record
Confirm the linked determination matches the decision the claimant describes
Done when the appeal is linked to both the parent claim and the determination
verify: Open the appeal record and follow both links back to the claim and the determination

sop: Count the days from the adverse determination to the appeal received date

Record the timeliness result on the appeal record with the day count

verify: Recount the days from the two recorded dates

sop: Record whether the appeal came from the claimant, an attorney or an authorised representative

Set the correspondence routing to the representative where the authorisation permits it

Pass when every representative submission has a filed authorisation

sop: Route the appeal to the dedicated appeals queue rather than the original handling desk

Done when the appeal sits on the appeals queue away from the original handler
verify: Read the assigned handler on the appeal and compare it to the original decision maker
Pass when the appeal is not assigned to the handler who made the original determination

steps.title: Confirm the registration is complete and start the appeal clock
sop: Review the appeal record for received date, links, submitter type and routing
Confirm the appeal decision clock is running from the received date
Log any registration defect with the correction owner and due date
Done when the registration review is recorded and the clock is confirmed running
verify: Read the appeal record and the decision due date shown by the system
Pass when the appeal is fully registered and the due date derives from the received date

generic.Defined scope/population: The appeal determination on one adverse disability decision reviewed de novo on the full record
generic.In-scope period: The 45 days from appeal receipt plus one documented 45-day extension where notice issued in time
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Determination outcome, reviewer, decision date, de novo attestation and argument-by-argument reasoning
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Arguments addressed in the rationale reconcile to the arguments listed in the appeal submission
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Determination rationale saved with reviewer, decision date and the record index version relied on
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Timeline breaches and unaddressed arguments logged with the cause and the remediation owner
generic.Test population: All appeal determinations rendered in the review period across clinical and non-clinical appeals
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the decision issued outside the appeal window without a timely extension notice on file
generic.Exception handling path: Breaches escalate to the Claims Quality Assurance / Training Manager for root cause and compliance reporting
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Determination recorded within the ERISA window with reviewer and date and each claimant argument addressed
generic.Evidence location: Appeal record and compliance clock task in the claims management platform and workflow tool

steps.title: Confirm the review considered all evidence including new appeal evidence

Record the evidence list on the appeal determination rationale

Pass when every indexed item including new appeal evidence appears in the evidence list

steps.title: Record the de novo attestation confirming no deference to the original decision

verify: Read the rationale for the de novo statement and its author
Pass when the rationale confirms de novo review with no deference to the original decision

steps.title: Weigh the independent clinical and vocational opinions in the rationale
sop: Summarise the independent opinions and the restrictions each supports or rejects

Cite each opinion by reviewer name, specialty and date in the rationale
Done when the rationale weighs each independent opinion with a citation
verify: Trace each clinical conclusion in the rationale to a filed signed opinion

sop: List every argument in the appeal submission as a numbered item

Log the notice send date against the compliance clock task before the original due date

sop: Enter the outcome as upheld, overturned or partially overturned on the structured field

Close the compliance clock task so elapsed days are captured on the appeal record

steps.title: Review the appeal determination against the ERISA appeal checklist
sop: Check the determination file for de novo attestation, evidence list, argument resolutions and timeliness
Log any deficiency with the cause and the corrective action owner
Release the determination for letter generation once the checklist is clear

verify: Read the checklist review note and the exception log for the appeal
Pass when the checklist is complete and every deficiency carries a disposition

generic.Defined scope/population: ERISA appeal compliance metrics for the reporting period delivered to regulatory affairs and legal
generic.In-scope period: Appeals received or decided between the reporting period start and end dates
generic.Required fields populated and valid: On-time rate, extension counts, overturn rate, deemed exhaustion count and breach detail per claim
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Appeal counts in the report reconcile to appeal records in the claims management platform for the period
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Report and source extract retained with extract date, period label and preparer name
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Breaches listed individually with claim reference, cause and the remediation owner
generic.Test population: All appeals with a decision due or issued within the reporting period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any timeliness breach is aggregated rather than listed with a claim reference and cause
generic.Exception handling path: Data discrepancies route to the Claims Analyst for correction and the report is reissued with a version note
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Report issued for the period showing on-time rate, extensions and overturn rate with every breach listed
generic.Evidence location: Report and workbook filed to the claim file repository with the platform extract retained

steps.title: Extract appeal timeline data for the period from the claims management platform
sop: Run the appeal extract with received date, due date, extension date, decision date and outcome
Record the extract date and row count on the reporting workbook
Reconcile the row count to the platform appeal count for the period
Done when the extract is loaded and reconciled to the platform count
verify: Compare the workbook row count to the platform appeal count for the period
Pass when the counts reconcile for the reporting period

steps.title: Calculate the percentage of appeal decisions issued within the 45-day window
sop: Calculate elapsed days from appeal receipt to decision for each appeal
Mark each as on time against the 45-day window or the documented extension window
Compute the on-time percentage for the period and compare it to the prior period
Done when the on-time rate is calculated for the period
verify: Recompute two appeals by hand from their received and decision dates
Pass when the recomputed results match the workbook classification

steps.title: List every timeliness breach individually with claim reference and cause
sop: List each appeal decided outside its window with claim reference, days late and handler

Assign each breach a remediation owner and target date

verify: Count the listed breaches against the appeals marked late in the workbook

steps.title: Report extensions taken and whether each notice issued before the original deadline
sop: Count the appeals where an extension was taken in the period
Compare each extension notice send date to the original decision due date
Report the count of extensions and the count of late extension notices
Done when extension counts and late notice counts are reported
verify: Spot check two extension notices against their original due dates
Pass when each checked notice classification matches the report

steps.title: Report the overturn rate and the top denial reasons overturned on appeal
sop: Calculate the overturn and partial overturn rate for closed appeals in the period
Rank the original denial reasons by overturn volume
Note any reason where the overturn rate moved materially against the prior period
Done when the overturn rate and ranked denial reasons are reported
verify: Recompute the overturn rate from the closed appeal rows
Pass when the recomputed rate matches the reported rate

steps.title: Report the count of appeals where deemed exhaustion was triggered
sop: Identify appeals where the plan failed to decide within the window and deemed exhaustion applies
List each with the claim reference and whether litigation followed
Report the count and the trend against the prior period
Done when the deemed exhaustion count and detail are reported
verify: Match each deemed exhaustion entry to a breach entry on the breach list
Pass when every deemed exhaustion case also appears on the breach list

steps.title: Circulate the report to regulatory affairs and legal with exceptions flagged
sop: Review the report for litigation-sensitive content and confirm the exception detail is accurate
Circulate the report to regulatory affairs and legal with the exceptions flagged for action
File the report and workbook to the claim file repository with the period label

verify: Confirm the filed report carries the period label and the exception list
Pass when the report is issued for the period with on-time rate, extensions and overturn rate

generic.Defined scope/population: Appeal outcome data captured on every closed appeal record in the tracking period

generic.Required fields populated and valid: Outcome code, primary reason, elapsed days, reinstatement flag and retroactive payment flag
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Closed appeal outcome counts reconcile to open and closed appeal records for the period

steps.title: Record each appeal outcome using the standard code list in the claim system
sop: Set the outcome on each closed appeal as upheld, overturned or partially overturned
Use the standard code list rather than free text so the data supports analysis
Correct any appeal closed without an outcome code and log the correction
Done when every closed appeal carries a standard outcome code
verify: List closed appeals for the period and check the outcome field on each

steps.title: Record the primary reason for each outcome to support pattern analysis
sop: Select the primary reason for the outcome from the reason code list
Take the reason from the appeal determination rationale rather than assuming it
Log any appeal where the rationale does not support a single primary reason
Done when every closed appeal carries a primary reason code
verify: Spot check two reason codes against their appeal determination rationales

steps.title: Record elapsed days from appeal receipt to decision on each appeal record
sop: Calculate elapsed days from the appeal received date to the decision date
Record the elapsed days on the appeal record so timeliness reporting can read it
Flag any appeal where the received or decision date is missing for correction
Done when elapsed days are recorded on every closed appeal
verify: Recalculate elapsed days for two appeals from their recorded dates

sop: For each overturned or partially overturned appeal, confirm benefits were reinstated

Raise an action where reinstatement or retroactive payment is outstanding

verify: List overturned appeals and read the reinstatement and payment fields on each

Compare the sum of outcome counts to the closed appeal count
Investigate and explain any difference before the data is used for reporting
Done when outcome counts reconcile to closed appeal records with differences explained
verify: Read the reconciliation lines in the workbook against the platform counts
Pass when the outcome totals reconcile to the closed appeal count for the period

steps.title: Review the outcome data quality before it feeds compliance reporting
sop: Review completeness of outcome codes, reasons, elapsed days and reinstatement flags
Log every gap with an owner and a correction due date
Release the dataset for compliance and pattern reporting once gaps are closed
Done when the data quality review is recorded and gaps are assigned
verify: Read the review note and the open correction items for the period
Pass when every closed appeal has outcome code, reason and elapsed days recorded
